name.en: AP Post Matric Scholarship: Maintenance Fee (MTF), ITI

summary.en: Rs.10,000 per year for food and hostel expenses

name.en: Bank account of the student's mother (or natural guardian if the mother has passed away or is absent)

en: The amount is credited to the mother's bank account, or to the natural guardian's account if the mother has passed away or is absent.

to_confirm: Family income limit, native/domicile rules and required documents are not in the sources checked; confirm on jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in
Application dates change every academic year; check Jnanabhumi

sources.title: Post Matric Scholarship scheme description, Jnanabhumi (Social Welfare Dept, AP)
